title: Nine Kettles and a Tuesday
subtitle: 沐浴与洗浴 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 沐浴与洗浴（生活与学习·日常生活）
meta: 主题语境：沐浴与洗浴（生活与学习·日常生活）　|　核心词汇：bath　|　正文 325 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bath 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother carried nine kettles for ① a bath and called it a luxury, and my grandmother called it a Tuesday. The ② bath, meaning the water and not the tub, was shared by three people and was never once hot; a bath, she said, is the only comfort that is measured by how many have gone before you.

Every ③ bath in that house was taken in the same order, and the ④ bath on a Sunday, meaning the one with the door locked and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever looked forward to. A bath, my father said, is nine parts fuel and one part privacy; my mother said the fuel is the part you notice.

My aunt meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ bath was the whole of the room, meaning the place and not the water. The ⑥ bath, meaning the room with the tap and not any of that, is the only room in a house that everybody queues for and nobody stays in; a bath, she said, is either something you sit in or the only word that means both the water and the room. He said the room came later.

By 1963 the ⑦ bath had become a photograph in a brochure, and the brochure had become an argument about the plumbing. The ⑧ bath of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine kettles and eleven years of Tuesdays; a bath, she said, is either the water in the tub or the reason you learned to wait your turn. She said the waiting was the part that taught everybody.

The ⑨ bath I remember is the Sunday one, which was never hot and was never missed. A ⑩ bath, my grandmother said in 1966, is the only thing that improves by being shared; every bath, she said, is a room that has agreed to look like a comfort. He said the comfort was never in the water.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 洗澡水；一缸浴水
B. n. 洗澡水（指那些水，与浴缸相对）
C. 固定搭配：carry nine kettles for a bath 为洗澡提／烧九壶水
D. n. 洗澡（指屋里每一次）
E. n. 洗澡（指星期天那一次）
F. n. 浴室；洗澡间（指那间屋）
G. n. 浴室（抽象：带水龙头的那间房）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bath and called it a luxury
The bath, meaning the water and not the tub
bath was the whole of the room
The bath, meaning the room with the tap
the bath had become a photograph in a brochure
The bath of the whole thing

answers.why: carry nine kettles for a bath 意为“为洗一次澡提九壶水”，1946 年母亲提了九壶水，管它叫奢侈。
bath 意为“洗澡水”，指那些水而不是浴缸，三个人共用，从来没热过。
bath 指屋里每一次洗澡，那屋里每一次都按同一个顺序。
bath 指星期天那一次洗澡（锁上门的那一次），是唯一有人盼着的。
bath 意为“浴室、洗澡间”，指那间屋，姑姑说 bath 就是那间屋的全部，指的是地方而不是水。
bath 为抽象用法，指带水龙头的那间房，是一家人人排队、却没人久留的房间。
bath 意为“洗澡水”，到 1963 年这个 bath 成了宣传册上的一张照片。
bath 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九壶水和十一个星期二。
bath 意为“洗澡（那缸水）”，我记得的是星期天那一次，它从来没热过，也从没被错过。
bath 为抽象总称，祖母说洗澡是唯一会因为共用而变好的事。
